book.name: Mark
book.title: Rongmwehu ma insingdi jang ipen Mark

content: Doahr Padahk in mihn Mehjjok
Pharisee pwi apel jounpadahk in Kojonnedpwi indoa jang Jerusalem pokonpene ipen Jesus.
Irai soahkda doahr epwi Nah sohnpadahkkok kin mwingehki poa jamin — nehn ahr johkin amwumw doahr siahkko ma Pharisee‑ok pwehng armaj ohroj en wia.
(Pwa Pharisee‑ok apel mihn Jew ohroj, kin japjang siahkkok ma irai oaloa jang ipen mihn Jew in mehjjok: ioar ma irai johkin mwingehki ma arai johpwa amwumwla;
apel irai johkin kang mehkij ma wijikdo jang wijahn noasnoas kan, ma irai johpwa amwunla.
Irai kin pel wia siahk dir ma irai oaloahjang mihn mehj kan: doahroar amwumw mwoak, amwumw pileis, amwumw pwohl kapa, apel pehd kan.)

Pharisee‑ok apel jounpadahk in Kojonneddok idoak ipen Jesus, pwehng Ih, “Maing, amwda nihmw sohnpadahk kan johkin pwilihki kapwaihahda siahk koadoaudoaudo en jamasai mihn mehjjok, nehn irai kin pwili mwinge a johkin amwumwla.”
A Jesus japoang irai,

content.text: “Mehlel oar pwa uhdahn pwung en Isaiah kohpda doahr amwai mwalaun en, doahr ma ne insingdi.
‘Koahs pwa, armaj pwiai kin woaunki Ngoahi jang in arai lal
a mohngiongirai inenin dohjang Ngoahi.
Johpwa kaspoan ahr kin joarwihoang Ngoahi,
pwa irai kin padahkki kojonned in armaj, a irai karaunki pwa en Koahs Kojonned.’”

content: Ih pel pwa,

content.text: “Kamwai kin kerpwihla kojonned in Koahs, a kin injinohkihoar kapwaihahda siahk kadoaudoau in armaj kan.”

content: Ih pel doaudoaula pwa,

content.text: “Kamwai inenin loalkoangin joah oaloahda kojonned in Koahs, pwa kamwai en kauj pein amwai padahk kan.
Pwa Moses koajoanehdi pwa, ‘Koawoa woaunki joamoamw apel inoamw,’ apel ‘Ma emen ma pirin lahlahwe jamah ke inah, ih pirin kojkojdi.’
A kamwai wud kin padahkihwe, ‘Ma armaj men anki ekij ma ih kak jeuwejehki jamah apel inah, a kin pwa, “Corban me”

content: (woahwoahki “oang Koahs”),

content.text: ih pwa ih ne johla anki pwukoahn jeuweje jamah apel inah.’
Doari, ioar doahr amwai kin koauwehla mahjan in Koahs nehn amwai kin pein padahkihoang armaj kan siahk kan ma kamwai kin pein wiahda. Apel mine siahk dir ma doahroar me ma kamwai kin wihwia.”

content: Dahioau kin Kajaminihla Armaj
Jesus pel pangindo pokonno Ipoa, pwehng irai,

content.text: “Kamwai rong apel woahwoahki mwehu me:
Johpwa mehkij ma kin aluhwoang nehn koawoa jang likin kak kajaminihla koawoa, pwa mehkan ma kin injang loaloa, ioar ma kin kajaminihla koawoa.
[Kamwai rong ma mine siamwai mihn rong wija.]”

content: Nehn Ah injang ipen armajjok dilda nehn ummwo, Nah sohnpadahkkok idoak Ipoa woahwoahn karajraj oauwe.
Ih ken pwehng irai,

content.text: “Da, kamwai johpwa loalkoang jang armaj pwian? Kamwai jehjoa pwa joh mehkij mihn likin armaj kin dilda loaloa kajaminihla,
pwa ih johkin inla nehn mohngiong, pwa nehn ah pehk in mwingehu, wijahu a ih kin injang loaloa inla likin palwarro.”

content: (Nehn Ah pwa me, Jesus kadehdehda pwa joangoan mwinge ohroj mwehu oang armaj.)
Doahr Ih ken pwa,

content.text: “Me kin indahjang nehn armaj, ioar ma kin kajaminihla armaj
pwa jang loaloan armaj, jang nehn ah mohngiong, ma lamlam nauna kan kin indahjang, ma kin kahrehioang nehn dipen siahk nauna, nenek, pirap, kojarmaj,
kamwahl, noaroak apel wia joangoan siahk nauna kan ohroj; kapweipwei armaj, nauna joaroa, pihrin, lahlahwe, aklaplap apel joah injino —
joang nauna pwiai ohroj kin sapjang loaloan armaj, ioar kin kajaminihla armaj.”

content: En Lihmen Pwojon
Jesus ken inlahjang wijahu, inlahng nehn wein Tyre. Ih dilda nehn ummwo a Ih johpwa nimen armaj kan en kidal pwa Ih mine wijahu; a Ih johkak joaloangla.
Pwa lihmen ma ngen jaus dilingla nah jerpeinno, liho kidalda pwa Jesus mine wijahu, ih ken dildahr Ipoa nehn ummwo dairukdihoang in pwoalkoa.
Lihn likin men ih, ih noaisikdi Phoenicia nehn wein Syria. Ih ken poaki ipen Jesus en kaujjang ngen jausso ipen nah jerpeinno.
Doari Jesus ken japoang, pwehng ih,

content.text: “Kisai kamwinge jerihkan mijoa, johpwa pwung en kihjang kenen jerihkan mwinge peidlahng doahk kan.”

content: Liho japoang pwehng Ih,

content.text: “Mehlel Maing, a doahk kan kin pel pwili kang in kenen jerihkan pehn sehpil kan!”

content: Jesus ken japoang,

content.text: “Pwa doahroar oamw pajpoang en, alwe in umwoammwo; pwa ngen jausso ne injang ipen nihmw jerpeinno.”

content: Liho ken pwurla in umwahu kidalda pwa nah jerpeinno onohn nehn dohiahu; a ngen jausso ne injang ipoa.
Jesus Kemwehuwihla Woal Pongpong apel Jehjoa Lallal men
Jesus inlahjang Tyre, Ih wud ipen Sidon, inlahng Lehn Galilee, kosehla wein Decapolis.
Armaj pwi ken ukdohng Ih woal pongpong apel jehjoa lallal men, poaki en kihdahng poah pohn ih.
Jesus ken ukjang woallo nehn pokonno, Ih ken dilimmoang jandin poah nehn pwokin sioa, kioang pilen oawoa in jandin poah, jairki loawoan woallo.
Jesus ken jardahla nehnloannge, pwahla,

content.text: “Ephphatha,”

content: ma woahwoahki,

content.text: “woahjekpijoang!”

content: Anjoauwohr pwokin sien woallo woahjekpijoang apel joalin loawoa lapwadekla; ih ken sapda lallal.
Jesus ken pwehng ihr ohroj en johpwa pwehng emen mehkije. A doahr uhwen lal sihkei ma Ih wiahng arai, ioar doahr sihkei in ahr lohkihjili manman oauwe.

Irai ohroj ma pwili rong wioapoan manman oauwe, irai ken pwuriamweikihla pwahpwahpwa, “Me ohroj Ih kin wiahda inenin mwehu! Pwa Jesus kin nimen armaj pongpong kan en rongda wija apel kalallalihda armaj loahsoang kan!”
